paragraphs.text:
You  and  Norman  sneak  into  the  encampment,  fully  aware 
that  the  sasquatches  may  be  nocturnal  and  have  sharper 
senses than you.

Make a Stealth roll for you and Norman: if you both succeed, go to 
393; otherwise, go to 390.
